name: Alamo Certified Farmers' Market
tagline: Alamo Certified Farmers Market – All Bay
description: Alamo Certified Farmers' Market gathers local farms and food producers in 110 Alamo Plaza, CA. The market is a hub for seasonal produce, baked goods, and artisan products from nearby growers. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
